A Slower Weekend in London

A flexible first weekend in London, built around Covent Garden and Greenwich.

By Travelber Editorial · Updated 19 October 2026

IN THIS GUIDE

Arrival: keep the evening easyDay one: Covent GardenDay two: GreenwichWeather and getting aroundOfficial sources
← United Kingdom overview

Arrival: keep the evening easy

Check in, settle your luggage and take a short walk near your base. Save the main sightseeing for a full day. Compare where to stay in London before booking.

Day one: Covent Garden

Give Covent Garden the main block of your day. Check the official visitor information for ticketing and access, then leave the afternoon open for nearby streets, food and a slower walk.

Day two: Greenwich

Build the next day around Greenwich. Verify the journey from your accommodation and leave time to collect luggage before departure. If your return is early, choose one short visit instead of trying to finish a checklist.

Weather and getting around

Christmas and New Year rail journeys can be affected by planned engineering works; check your specific travel dates. Keep an indoor option for changeable weather.

National Rail covers Great Britain; use Translink for Northern Ireland journeys, including Belfast. Belfast is not connected to Great Britain by a direct rail route.
